v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He guards the goal as if every puck were an unannounced inspection. In HyperNorm he classifies arrivals as stopped or regrettable. The glove catches complaints; the mask is carried aside so he can see the complainants. A dissonant card suggests that leaving a doorway open could also be a save. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er hält den Kasten dicht. Für Besucher wurde ein anderes Problem eingerichtet.

persoenlichkeit.v: She considers the blue line a perfectly reasonable place to end a conversation.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: She considers the blue line a perfectly reasonable place to end a conversation. She patrols the corridor's imaginary blue line with a wooden stick and a firm sense of jurisdiction. Everything is either onside or somebody else's fault. She occasionally moves the line to let an exhausted neighbour pass. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Grenze ist eindeutig. Ihre Lage bleibt Verhandlungssache.

persoenlichkeit.v: He organises every face-off around his personal need to be right.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He organises every face-off around his personal need to be right. He directs courtyard play while presenting the puck as evidence that the centre must belong to someone. An ambiguous card asks whether a team can move without a central authority. He has started passing before finishing his explanation. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er ist der Mittelpunkt. Die anderen werden entsprechend verschoben.

persoenlichkeit.v: He is ready to accelerate as soon as somebody explains which way.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He is ready to accelerate as soon as somebody explains which way. He carries the skate as a promise that one day the route will become obvious. The building divides residents into advancing and obstructing. A dissonant card has made him consider that waiting for a neighbour might count as movement. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Schlittschuh ist bereit. Die Richtung ist noch im Verfahren.

persoenlichkeit.v: She scores chiefly to interrupt the captain's speech.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: She scores chiefly to interrupt the captain's speech. Her puck is a portable interruption to compulsory team briefings. She divides announcements into useful and still going. When a contradictory card proposes listening, she offers the quiet residents the first turn to speak. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie verkürzt die Ansprache. Meist durch ein Tor.

persoenlichkeit.v: He serves every penalty with the dignity of a wrongly filed invoice.

v.vorschlag: English dry warm tragically bureaucratic character voice; no audio selected

backstory.v: He serves every penalty with the dignity of a wrongly filed invoice. He measures his penalty with a little brass timer and sorts everyone into innocent or insufficiently informed. The building keeps adding minutes for disputing the count. He secretly uses some of them to hear a neighbour's side. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Strafzeit läuft. Eine Begründung wurde aus Zeitgründen vertagt.
